entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.code_description: Beauty or make-up preparations and preparations for the care of the skin (other than medicaments), including sunscreen or suntan preparations; manicure or pedicure preparations
entries.comment: This reduced rate applies only to ostomy care products  (part 2): Additional products for ostomy care: — pastes, powders, protective creams; 3304 — protection of the area around the ostomy (ostomy ring with skin protective fluids) and glue residue remover  for the skin (skin cleansing pads, skin cleansing solution as an aerosol); 3401 11 00, 3401 30 00, 3402 20 90, 3005 90 99, 9018 90 84 —ostomy odor neutralizing agents; 3307 90 00.
